text: Facing you once again, Felicia flashes her professional idol smile as usual.
I know, sooner or later, cats all want to know more about me, meow~
I do have a few questions I'd like to ask you.
Of course, ask away, meow.
Still have a lot to ask...
Can you tell me why you became an idol for monkeys?
Oh, that's hard to explain.
It sounds cliché, but it was destiny, meow.
Destiny?
After all, becoming an idol was something I never dared to dream of before.
Next...
Your eyes are captivating. Are they natural?
Oh, thank you! I wish I was born with heterochromia too, but unfortunately, it's part of my makeup.
Felicia tilts her head back slightly. Under the light, you can see the texture of the colored contacts.
My fans love to see me being unique, meow!
You've given a lot for your fans.
They've given me so much, of course I have to return their love!
She looks so proud, taking all of this for granted.
Next...
What did you do before you became an idol?
Lived on the streets.
Surprised? Actually, I had many friends around me back then. But I was the only cat who finally made it big.
What about them?
Her pretty features twist slightly, as if she's remembering something.
I don't know.
I haven't seen them since.
You must have sacrificed a lot for your fans, right?
Of course! My fans' support gave me everything I have now. For them, any sacrifice is worth it, meow!
So you even tolerate their stalking and prying into your private life? Leading to the orgy?
Felicia falls into a brief silence. She averts her gaze, unwilling to discuss it further.
That's... a different matter.
That cat...
You notice her hesitation, and after thinking, realize who she's referring to.
You mean Bob?
Mm, I think I saw him before, back when I was alive.
Huh?
There was a commotion backstage at one of my concerts once.
They caught a thief. The stolen items didn't seem to be worth much either.
Although some felt sorry for him, the cat was still reported and arrested according to procedure.
This seems to match the theft record in his file.
If I hadn't successfully become an idol, maybe I would have ended up like him.
You still want to ask..
Do you ever feel lonely? Being an idol for a different species, away from cat communities.
After several conversations, perhaps she finally trusts you, or perhaps because in this afterlife, the past no longer holds meaning. She drops the facade of the perfect idol and speaks her mind.
You see, my fans probably still think I really like bananas.
Such ignorant monkeys.
Hey! I won't allow you to talk about my fans like that, meow!
You disagree?
You stare at each other, until finally Felicia seems to deflate, and quite relaxedly shows a smile you'd call genuine.
Well, actually, you're not wrong.
You know this topic might be heavy, so you choose your words carefully.
I assume you know that the cause of death section in your file is blank.
Back then, I didn't remember how I got here.
Fortunately, Felicia is calm.
This calmness strikes you as somewhat unusual, but you press on.
Back then? What about now?
I remember, they cornered me.
They pressed down on me in the middle, and I finally passed out and ended up here.
So, her true cause of death was death from excessive indulgence.
All words feel inadequate; you don't know how to offer comfort.
Their love... Now I don't even know if it can be called love.
It wasn't.
Of this, there is no doubt.
If it wasn't...
Have I been deceiving myself all along?
She doesn't wait for your reply, just gets up as if in a daze.
You look at the document that belongs to her.
You still want to ask..
You still want to ask..
